notes.title: We've prepared the Complete Edition!
notes.notes:
Thank you always for your support.

In addition to the main game, we've prepared a bundle where you can purchase the DLC and soundtrack together.

▼ You can purchase it here!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36139/XALADIA_Rise_of_the_Space_Pirates_X2/

The Complete Edition is available at a slight discount. We'd be delighted if you could enjoy XALADIA not just for the main story but also with the DLC characters, weapons, and inclusive soundtrack.

We look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: Today, we have officially released the demo version of XALADIA!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the official demo version of XALADIA is now available. 

We would be delighted to hear your thoughts and impressions after playing it. 
Feel free to share your feedback on X or Discord; we're all ears wherever you are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012436/d09b6dbcfe32bb11a11808a9a17be9645c4793ba.png[/img]

Thank you always for your support.

notes.title: Second Trailer Released, Plus a Limited-Time Demo Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Second Trailer[/h1]
In the second trailer, we're unveiling key in-game features such as weapon variations, diverse turret placements for attacks, and even a glimpse of the boss alien mothership!

[previewyoutube=ulAmJg1ztyo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Limited-Time Public Demo[/h1]
From August 11th, 2023 (GMT 4:00pm) to August 13th, 2023 (GMT 4:00pm), we are offering a special early access to the demo on the Steam store page. Don't miss out and give it a try!
